description: Review data completeness, tune the scoring weights and confirm exclusions before generating the action ranking.
scoring-weights-description: Adjust how much each pillar contributes to the final ranking. Moving one slider redistributes the remainder proportionally across the other two.
scoring-weights-defaults: Default weights follow the standard methodology: Impact {{impact}}% · Alignment {{alignment}}% · Feasibility {{feasibility}}%
no-exclusion-criteria: No exclusion criteria set — all actions will be included in the ranking.
confirmed-exclusions-count_one: {{count}} action confirmed for exclusion. It will be removed from the ranking when you generate recommendations.
confirmed-exclusions-count_other: {{count}} actions confirmed for exclusion. These will be removed from the ranking when you generate recommendations.
no-confirmed-exclusions: No actions have been confirmed for exclusion yet.
legal-screening-note: Automatic legal screening runs when the ranking is generated: actions blocked by your municipality's regulations are excluded automatically.
